decision: Accept the staged dense-prefill change; native parity remains unmet
protocol: One shared GPU lock covering source-faithful builds, C++ checks, and five alternating baseline/candidate pairs; both pinned Qwen2.5-0.5B models and all three required workloads.
other_results: Every remaining decode/prefill median changed by less than one percent in these five pairs. This is a measured range, not proof of zero regression.
remaining_gap: The accepted build still misses every native throughput target and matches native full generated-ID digests on only three of six model/workload legs. No native-parity claim is made.
scope: BF16 matrices shorter than 32 rows retain the existing tiled path. Rejected GEMV, direct-RoPE, barrier, and batch-budget experiments are not enabled. No numerical tolerance or benchmark workload was relaxed.
reproduction: Build c19e1ecd and c2548675 separately with scripts/build-wheel.sh, create wheel-matched environments using requirements-baseline.txt, and run final_dense_matrix.py with candidate root, baseline root, candidate Python, and candidate wheel. Baseline root must contain its dist-parity-release wheel and receipts/parity-baseline-20260908 artifacts. The recorded machine-specific bootstrap is dense-prefill-final-m1.sh.
